user.title: Add TeklaPellet module
user.description: Modules on the network are discovered automatically. Otherwise enter its address (IP or name, VPN works too).

pair.title: Pair with {name}
pair.description: Enter the device password (same as in the app). It is used once; Home Assistant stores a client token, not the password.

error.locked: Too many attempts, try again in a minute.
error.too_many_clients: The module already has 8 paired clients.
error.not_configured: Module is not configured yet - use the app (Bluetooth) or its service page.

init.title: Access level and refresh
init.description: The level decides which panel parameters can be selected as entities. The PIN is only verified, never stored.

entities.title: Entities
entities.description: Only the connectivity sensor is created by default. The panel card works independently of this selection.

error.pin_level_too_low: This PIN gives a lower level than selected.
error.locked: Too many attempts, try again in 5 minutes.
